name: to-adsb-surface-status-is-no-kind
reference: pyModeS bds65: subtype 1 is the surface status; adsb-df18 maps its capability class as adsb.capability_class, which adsb's surface kind does not hold (it requires the surface capability class and the length/width code), and the subtype now requires its value, so the message is no-kind, not an airborne status
